title: Rooms and narrow spaces take their skylight from the world round them
summary: Rooms under a roof, wall feet and gaps between houses lose skylight; open ground is unchanged.
stage: --scenario=breach --seed=3 --mood=day --fixed-fps 30. Room: --focus=0,-30 --zoom=8 --pitch=-62 at 5 s, roof lifted by the defenders inside. Gap between houses: --focus=7.5,-27 --zoom=4.5 --pitch=-14 at 12 s. Destruction: --focus=12,-31 --zoom=14 --pitch=-50 --blast-at=14,-29,3,6, 60 frames every 0.1 s.
rationale: Each sheet is cropped tight on where probes matter. OFF is a --set=light_probes:0 run; ON, the probe term and the bent normal are consecutive frames of a --set=light_probes:2 run cycling them (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_AB=cycle). The scenario is deterministic at a fixed frame rate, so OFF and ON are the same moment (only smoke differs). The flicker clip alternates them on one frame; the destruction clip pairs the game with the probe term from a second identical run (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_VIEW=1).

capture.provenance: Recaptured off-screen from this branch (Forward+, RTX 3090, High preset) with the commands in stage; panels are consecutive frames of one fixed-fps run, so they share camera, units and smoke.
capture.comparison: Sheets: top left probes off, bottom left on, top right the probe term (sky share on grey, bounce amplified), bottom right the bent normal. Flicker: off and on alternate each second on one frame. Destruction: the game and the probe term from two identical fixed-fps runs.
capture.limits: Measured in the crops: the room falls to 0.69 of its brightness (sunlit floor 0.57, shaded floor 0.47); between the houses the shaded wall and its foot to 0.94-0.95; the sunlit roof and open grass stay at 1.00. Smoke differs between the OFF and ON runs. Trenches are narrower than the 2 m grid and are not shown. The Compatibility renderer (browser) gets the skylight shading but not the indoor sun cut.

source_ref: dines/probe-grid-gi-0571ca: the daylight tuning commit after 34bac81a.
